after: Offer the minimum amount only once per product. If the customer refuses it, that is a flat refusal: move to the next attempt proposal and do not offer the minimum amount again.
brief_quote: If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.
rationale: Stops the floor being offered a second time after a refusal.

before: It did not go through a second time. Do not try again. Tell the customer you could not save it because of a technical problem.
after: It did not go through a second time. Do not try again. Tell the customer in a few words that you could not save it because of a technical problem. Note this product with reason system_error, keep the promises already recorded, and then continue with the next open product.
brief_quote: If one create_promise fails twice, keep the promises that were recorded and note the failed product with reason system_error.
rationale: Makes the agent note system_error and continue with remaining products instead of ending the call.
